evidence_state: Evidence was generated against the immutable implementation commit or an authorized remediation worktree with only authorized remediation changes, authorized evidence-script changes, documentation changes, and schema-1.4 tracked provenance additions; every current acceptance entry identifies its exact state.
containing_commit_binding: This manifest is committed in the Git commit that contains this manifest. The containing commit hash is intentionally not embedded.
self_reference_limitation: Embedding the containing commit or requiring a Full guard transcript to validate its own final hash would be self-referential. Full guard runs skip only their own changing transcript hash; staged evidence records its pre-final capture point.
independent_audit_requirement: An independent audit must obtain the containing commit from Git and verify its parent, branch, production-source scope, manifest content, referenced hashes, retained input inventories, and final clean synchronized status.
historical_binary_limitation: The earlier implementation-checkpoint binaries are no longer available for independent byte or semantic comparison, so their exact equivalence to later binaries cannot be retroactively proven. Their hashes remain historical observations only. The earlier A/B rebuild also lacked retained raw tlog provenance and used an ignored untracked producer; acceptance now relies on the schema-1.4 provenance-complete A/B rebuild under artifacts/logs/production-orchestration-ab-tlog-provenance/.

ab_rebuild_contract.normalization_justification: A/B normalized equality is obtained only by zeroing linker timestamps, the derived PE checksum, debug-directory timestamps, and the per-build CodeView GUID. Executable-section bytes, imports, normalized disassembly, normalized symbols, retention boundaries, target/request absence, and Authenticode state are equal without exclusion.
ab_rebuild_contract.input_identity_method: Complete pre-build input identity is derived from compiler/linker tracking log closure: ChatpadFilter CL/link tlogs, ChatpadKmdfRequestOwnerContext project-reference CL/lib producer tlogs, explicit solution/project/Directory.Build.props files, external headers/libraries/system reads, and toolchain executable identity. Generated repo-local obj/lib intermediates are resolved through their producer tlog closure instead of treated as pre-build source inputs.

status_mapping.framework_status_rule: Returned only for the four creation-failure results and only when failing.
